text:
maya-cs: Quick sync — Harmonix onboarding: latency SLO drift noticed this morning (p99 spike ~1.8s). Need credit calc and customer update by EOD. @jared-ops can you pull the window and confirm root cause? ping @olivia-csm

jared-ops: on it. seeing deploy-bot alert at 08:12 UTC. looking at model routing and batching configs.

sre-bot: ALERT Harmonix-service p99_latency > 1.5s for 5m (08:12-08:17 UTC). Link: https://dash.redwood/harmonix/alerts/987

priya-support: ticket created #CS-4321 with customer logs. They reported intermittent slow responses since yesterday evening.

jared-ops: quick query I'm running:
```
SELECT percentile(latency_ms, 99) FROM requests
WHERE customer='harmonix' AND timestamp >= now()-24h
GROUP BY hour
```
prelim: p99 baseline 600ms, spike to 1800ms during 2 windows (03:10-03:30, 08:12-08:20)

olivia-csm: customer expects two things: 1) explanation, 2) credit amount. Can we provide a simple calc and commit to timeframe?

maya-cs: propose credit calc: follow SLA doc: credit = downtime minutes / total minutes * monthly fee capped at 30%. For latency SLO we do 'latency breach credit' for >=N% requests above threshold. Let's compute both. @jared-ops can you produce exact minutes and percentage?

jared-ops: will run a script and attach numbers in thread in 20m. early estimate: uptime unaffected (no availability outage), but latency breach ~1.8% of requests over 24h => using latency-credit matrix = 5% credit. will confirm.

priya-support: I'll include draft comms template: short apology, what happened, mitigation, credit math, how they can redeem. paste draft later.

maya-cs: thanks. Action items: jared -> confirm numbers + root cause; priya -> draft comms; olivia -> schedule 1:1 with customer for tomorrow 10am PT. I'll update handoff doc after numbers.

olivia-csm: noted. adding calendar invite and setting expectation for written update before EOD.

jared-ops: update: root cause is routing mismatch after autoscale burst — KV cache warmup + model fallback to bigger variant. fix: pin routing policy + cache ttl increase. Rolling change deployed at 09:05 UTC, p99 back to 650ms.

maya-cs: perfect. please paste final numbers and I'll calculate credit and send comms.

priya-support: draft comms ready, attaching snippet:
```
Hi Harmonix team — sorry about the slow responses earlier today. We identified root cause (routing fallback + cache warmup) and deployed fix at 09:05 UTC. P99 latency during impacted windows was 1.8s, which represents 1.9% of requests over 24h. Per our SLA, this maps to a 5% monthly credit. We'll apply it to your next invoice. Let us know if you'd like a walkthrough.
```

maya-cs: sending after jared confirms. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
